name: DevOS
description: AI-powered developer command center designed to bring tasks, focus sessions, and project threads into one place.
problem: Building alone means context lives in five places at once — a task list, a terminal, a notes file, a chat with an AI assistant, and whatever was open when you stopped. DevOS came out of my own workflow: one command center where the task, the focus session and the project thread are the same object, so picking work back up does not require reconstructing it.

challenges.title: Context that survives a break
challenges.detail: Tasks alone were not enough to resume work. Attaching session notes and decisions to a persistent project thread turned resumption from re-reading code into reading four lines.

challenges.title: Keeping AI grounded in the project
challenges.detail: Generic assistant answers were useless. Requests now carry a trimmed slice of the project thread and recent sessions, so suggestions reference actual decisions instead of guessing.

challenges.title: Avoiding another tool to maintain
challenges.detail: The system only works if updating it is a side effect of working. Ending a focus block prompts a one-line note, and that single habit keeps the whole thread current.
